name: Gobinda Bhog Paddy Seed
shortDescription: Gobinda Bhog Paddy Seed from SRABANI SEED FARM.
description: Gobinda Bhog is a famous traditional short-grain aromatic rice variety native to West Bengal. Valued for its rich natural aroma and delicate culinary appeal in festive bhog and payesh preparations, SRABANI SEED FARM prepares Gobinda Bhog seeds with rigorous care to retain varietal purity and sound grain health.
features: Preserved for true-to-type aroma and cooking quality
Graded and screened to remove chaff and inert matter
Carefully dried to optimal moisture for maximum shelf stability

name: Badsha Bhog Paddy Seed
shortDescription: Badsha Bhog Paddy Seed from SRABANI SEED FARM.
description: Badsha Bhog is a celebrated traditional scented paddy variety cultivated across Bengal. Recognized for its sweet floral scent and slender-medium grain texture, SRABANI SEED FARM provides genuine Badsha Bhog seeds that undergo systematic grading and seed lot monitoring to support farmers cultivating premium fragrant rice.
features: Prized Bengal heritage scented rice variety
Distinct sweet fragrance and slender grain structure
Strict grading ensures uniform seed density and size
Direct from Sabang, Paschim Medinipur distribution
